knowledge.label: Knowledge
knowledge.tooltip: Knowledge = content you intend to internalize / own / use. Enters the review queue; active engagement.

reference.label: Reference
reference.tooltip: Reference = lookup material to find later. Lightweight save, no engagement gate.

demote.title: Demote knowledge → reference?
demote.body: Demotion is the anti-drift guard; it requires confirmation (ADR-0029 §4.5). The note will no longer enter the review queue. Upgrading back is always available.

driveAuth.label: Drive sync
driveAuth.blurb: knowlet syncs your vault via Google Drive's appData folder (invisible to your normal Drive UI).
driveAuth.connectingHint: Complete the Google sign-in in your browser. This window will refresh automatically.
driveAuth.disconnectConfirm: Tokens will be deleted locally. Drive itself keeps everything you've pushed.

syncMode.label: Sync mode
syncMode.autoHint: Default — surface conflicts in the inbox; never block.
syncMode.autoUpgradedHint_one: Auto upgraded to Strict — {{count}} device detected on this vault.
syncMode.autoUpgradedHint_other: Auto upgraded to Strict — {{count}} devices detected on this vault.
syncMode.strictHint: Block the app on any unresolved conflict (multi-device).
syncMode.laxHint: Surface conflicts in the inbox quietly; never block. Same as Auto today.
syncMode.blockingSubtitle: Strict mode is on. {{count}} unresolved {{noun}} block your work.
syncMode.blockingHint: Click a row to merge. The app unlocks once all are resolved.

llm.label: AI provider
llm.blurb: AI is optional — knowlet is a complete note-taking app without it. Configure any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (URL + key + model) to enable AI assistance in capture / mine / search flows. knowlet doesn't evaluate or recommend specific models — pick what suits you and judge from results.
llm.apiKeyPlaceholderKeepExisting: Leave blank to keep existing key
llm.baseUrlHelp: OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Common: OpenAI / Anthropic official, OpenRouter, local cliproxyapi (http://127.0.0.1:8317/v1), LM Studio (http://localhost:1234/v1), etc.
llm.modelPlaceholder: Fill URL + key above, click ↻ to load list; or type directly
llm.modelsListFailed: Couldn't load model list from provider (usually URL or key is wrong). You can still type any model id.
llm.modelsRefreshHint: Click ↻ to fetch the model list from provider
llm.saveNeedsModel: Please pick or type a Model first (otherwise AI calls will fail)
llm.testNeedsKey: Save your API key first to test

vaultPortability.label: Vault portability
vaultPortability.blurb: Export a portable .zip of your vault, or merge another vault / markdown folder into this one. New notes land under imported/YYYY-MM-DD; notes that already exist (same id) are skipped, never overwritten.
vaultPortability.previewRestoreTitle: Will restore as a new vault (sibling)
vaultPortability.previewMergeTitle: Will merge into the current vault
vaultPortability.mergeDoneShort: Imported {{count}} note(s) ({{renamed}} renamed, {{skipped}} skipped). Open the imported/ folder in the file tree, or search to find them.
